text: 试问岭南应不好，却道：此心安处是吾乡
pinyin: shì wèn lǐng nán yīng bù hǎo, què dào, cǐ xīn ān chù shì wú xiāng
literal: try · ask · Lingnan · surely · not · good, but · say, this · heart · at ease · place · is · my · home
natural: Is Lingnan so bad, I asked; she said, wherever my heart is at peace is my home

meaning.en: Home is wherever you feel at peace, so a remote or exiled place can still be home.
meaning.zh: 心安定的地方就是故乡，身处异地也能安之若素。

equivalents: home is where the heart is
make peace with wherever you are

examples.zh: 刚到新城市时他很想家，后来才明白“试问岭南应不好，却道：此心安处是吾乡”。
examples.en: He missed home at first in the new city, then realised the truth of this line.

examples.zh: 离乡多年的老人说：“试问岭南应不好，却道：此心安处是吾乡”，哪里住得安心哪里就是家。
examples.en: An old man long away from his village says home is wherever he can rest easy.

origin.source: 苏轼《定风波·南海归赠王定国侍人寓娘》

story.en: Su Shi wrote it for Yu Niang, the maid of his friend Wang Gong, who returned north from exile in Lingnan (the far south) still looking radiant; asked whether Lingnan was bad, she replied with this line.
story.zh: 苏轼为友人王巩之侍女寓娘而作：王巩南迁岭南归来，寓娘依然从容，苏轼问岭南好不好，她答以此句。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 夜阑风静縠纹平，小舟从此逝，江海寄余生
pinyin: yè lán fēng jìng hú wén píng, xiǎo zhōu cóng cǐ shì, jiāng hǎi jì yú shēng
literal: night · late · wind · still · crepe · ripples · flat, small · boat · from · now · depart, rivers · seas · entrust · remaining · life
natural: The night is late, the wind still and the ripples smooth; from here a little boat will sail away and I will give the rest of my life to rivers and seas

meaning.en: A wish to leave worldly cares behind and spend the rest of one's life free and at ease in nature.
meaning.zh: 想摆脱尘世的羁绊，把余生寄托于江海之间，自由自在。

equivalents: sail off into the sunset
spend one's remaining years in freedom

examples.zh: 退休那天他在朋友圈写下：“夜阑风静縠纹平，小舟从此逝，江海寄余生”。
examples.en: On the day he retired he posted this line on social media.

examples.zh: 厌倦了城市的喧嚣，她常默念“夜阑风静縠纹平，小舟从此逝，江海寄余生”。
examples.en: Tired of the city's noise, she often murmurs this line to herself.

story.en: Written while Su Shi was exiled in Huangzhou: after drinking late he returned home, found the servant asleep and unable to open the door, and stood by the river, dreaming of escaping official life.
story.zh: 苏轼贬居黄州时作：夜饮归来，家童鼾睡不应门，他倚杖听江声，生出摆脱仕途、江海寄身之想。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 腹有诗书气自华
pinyin: fù yǒu shī shū qì zì huá
literal: belly · have · poetry · books · air · by itself · radiant
natural: with poetry and books in one's belly, a natural radiance shows

meaning.en: A well-read person has a graceful, cultured bearing that needs no ornament.
meaning.zh: 饱读诗书的人，自然气质高雅、风度不凡。

equivalents: a well-read mind shows in one's bearing
knowledge gives one an air of distinction

examples.zh: 她不施粉黛，却“腹有诗书气自华”，让人过目难忘。
examples.en: She wears no make-up, yet her learning gives her an unforgettable air.

examples.zh: 读书会的口号就是“腹有诗书气自华”。
examples.en: The reading club's slogan is this line.

story.en: Su Shi wrote it for Dong Chuan, a poor scholar in shabby clothes, saying that his deep learning gives him a radiance no fine robes could.
story.zh: 苏轼赠董传之作：董传家贫衣敝，但饱读诗书，苏轼称其气度自然不凡。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 谁道人生无再少？门前流水尚能西！休将白发唱黄鸡
pinyin: shéi dào rén shēng wú zài shào, mén qián liú shuǐ shàng néng xī, xiū jiāng bái fà chàng huáng jī
literal: who · say · life · no · again · young? door · front · flowing water · even · can · west! don't · with · white · hair · sing · yellow · chicken
natural: Who says one cannot be young again? The stream before the door can still flow west! Do not sing of the yellow cock because your hair is white

meaning.en: Do not lament growing old; keep a youthful, upbeat spirit at any age.
meaning.zh: 不要为年老而悲叹，任何年纪都可以保持青春的精神。

equivalents: you're only as old as you feel
age is no barrier to spirit

examples.zh: 七十岁的奶奶报名学画画，说“谁道人生无再少？门前流水尚能西！休将白发唱黄鸡”。
examples.en: A seventy-year-old grandmother signs up for painting, quoting this line.

examples.zh: 同学聚会上，大家用“谁道人生无再少？门前流水尚能西！休将白发唱黄鸡”互相勉励。
examples.en: At the reunion everyone cheered each other on with this line.

origin.source: 苏轼《浣溪沙·游蕲水清泉寺》

story.en: Su Shi, exiled in Huangzhou, visited a temple whose stream flowed west, against the usual eastward flow of Chinese rivers, and took it as a sign that decline is not inevitable.
story.zh: 苏轼谪居黄州，游蕲水清泉寺，见溪水西流，有感而发，表达老当益壮、不叹衰老的乐观。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 白露横江，水光接天。纵一苇之所如，凌万顷之茫然
pinyin: bái lù héng jiāng, shuǐ guāng jiē tiān, zòng yī wěi zhī suǒ rú, líng wàn qǐng zhī máng rán
literal: white · dew · across · river, water · light · join · sky, let · one · reed · of · where it goes, cross · ten thousand · hectares · of · vastness
natural: White mist lies across the river and the water's gleam meets the sky; we let our reed-like boat drift where it will, across ten thousand acres of vastness

meaning.en: A vivid picture of a small boat drifting on a vast misty river under the autumn moon.
meaning.zh: 描写小舟在茫茫江面上随意漂荡、水天相接的开阔景象。

equivalents: a boat adrift on a boundless river

examples.zh: 作文里他引用“白露横江，水光接天。纵一苇之所如，凌万顷之茫然”来描写夜游长江。
examples.en: In his essay he quotes this line to describe a night trip on the Yangtze.

examples.zh: 站在湖心，我不禁想起“白露横江，水光接天。纵一苇之所如，凌万顷之茫然”。
examples.en: Standing mid-lake, I could not help thinking of this line.

story.en: From Su Shi's Former Ode on the Red Cliff (1082): on a night in the seventh month he and friends boated beneath the Red Cliff near Huangzhou, and he describes the river scene.
story.zh: 出自苏轼《赤壁赋》：元丰五年七月，苏轼与友人泛舟赤壁之下，此为描写江上夜景之句。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 寄蜉蝣于天地，渺沧海之一粟
pinyin: jì fú yóu yú tiān dì, miǎo cāng hǎi zhī yī sù
literal: lodge · mayfly · in · heaven · earth, tiny · blue · sea · of · one · grain
natural: We are mayflies lodged between heaven and earth, a tiny grain in the vast sea

meaning.en: Human life is as brief and small as a mayfly or a single grain of millet in the ocean.
meaning.zh: 感叹人生短暂、个体渺小，如同蜉蝣之于天地、一粟之于沧海。

equivalents: a drop in the ocean
here today, gone tomorrow

examples.zh: 面对浩瀚星空，他想起“寄蜉蝣于天地，渺沧海之一粟”。
examples.en: Facing the vast starry sky, he thinks of this line.

examples.zh: 文章用“寄蜉蝣于天地，渺沧海之一粟”来感叹个人在历史中的渺小。
examples.en: The essay uses this line to lament the smallness of the individual in history.

story.en: In the Ode, a guest sighs that, unlike Cao Cao and the river, humans are short-lived and small, setting up Su Shi's reply about the changing and the unchanging.
story.zh: 出自《赤壁赋》：客人吹箫伤怀，感叹人生短暂渺小，引出苏轼关于变与不变的回答。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 哀吾生之须臾，羡长江之无穷
pinyin: āi wú shēng zhī xū yú, xiàn cháng jiāng zhī wú qióng
literal: grieve · my · life · of · moment, envy · long · river · of · without · end
natural: I grieve that my life is a mere moment and envy the Yangtze's endlessness

meaning.en: A lament for the brevity of human life against the endless flow of nature.
meaning.zh: 感叹人生短暂，羡慕长江永无穷尽。

equivalents: life is short, nature is endless

examples.zh: 站在黄河边，他低声吟道：“哀吾生之须臾，羡长江之无穷”。
examples.en: Standing by the Yellow River, he softly recited this line.

examples.zh: “哀吾生之须臾，羡长江之无穷”道出了古人面对时间时的无奈。
examples.en: This line expresses the helplessness of the ancients before time.

story.en: Spoken by the guest in the Ode as he plays a sad flute tune and reflects on how short human life is compared with the river.
story.zh: 《赤壁赋》中客人洞箫呜咽，感慨人生与长江相比何其短暂。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 客亦知夫水与月乎？逝者如斯，而未尝往也；盈虚者如彼，而卒莫消长也
pinyin: kè yì zhī fú shuǐ yǔ yuè hū, shì zhě rú sī, ér wèi cháng wǎng yě, yíng xū zhě rú bǐ, ér zú mò xiāo zhǎng yě
literal: guest · also · know · that · water · and · moon · ?, passing · one · like · this, yet · never · gone · , waxing waning · one · like · that, yet · in the end · no · shrink · grow
natural: Do you know about water and the moon? The river flows on like this yet never goes away; the moon waxes and wanes yet in the end neither grows nor shrinks

meaning.en: Things change in form but their substance endures: the river keeps flowing yet remains, the moon wanes yet stays whole.
meaning.zh: 事物形态虽变，本质不变：江水流逝而长存，月亮圆缺而依旧。

equivalents: change on the surface, constancy beneath

examples.zh: 看开了得失，他想起苏轼的“客亦知夫水与月乎？逝者如斯，而未尝往也；盈虚者如彼，而卒莫消长也”。
examples.en: Having come to terms with gain and loss, he recalls this line of Su Shi.

examples.zh: 哲学课上，老师引用“客亦知夫水与月乎？逝者如斯，而未尝往也；盈虚者如彼，而卒莫消长也”讲变与不变。
examples.en: In philosophy class the teacher quoted this line to discuss change and permanence.

story.en: Su Shi's reply to the sad guest: using the river and the moon, he argues that all things are both changing and unchanging.
story.zh: 苏轼回答客人的悲叹，以江水与明月为喻，阐明万物既变又不变的道理。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 盖将自其变者而观之，则天地曾不能以一瞬；自其不变者而观之，则物与我皆无尽也
pinyin: gài jiāng zì qí biàn zhě ér guān zhī, zé tiān dì zēng bù néng yǐ yī shùn, zì qí bù biàn zhě ér guān zhī, zé wù yǔ wǒ jiē wú jìn yě
literal: if · from · its · changing · aspect · view · it, then · heaven · earth · not even · can · last · a · blink, from · its · unchanging · aspect · view · it, then · things · and · I · all · without · end
natural: Seen from what changes, heaven and earth cannot last even a blink; seen from what does not change, things and I are both endless

meaning.en: Your view depends on your standpoint: from change everything is fleeting, from constancy everything is eternal.
meaning.zh: 看问题的角度不同：从变化看，一切转瞬即逝；从不变看，万物与人都无穷无尽。

equivalents: it all depends on your point of view

examples.zh: 文章借“盖将自其变者而观之，则天地曾不能以一瞬；自其不变者而观之，则物与我皆无尽也”劝人放宽心胸。
examples.en: The essay uses this passage to urge a broader outlook.

examples.zh: 他在毕业赠言里抄下“盖将自其变者而观之，则天地曾不能以一瞬；自其不变者而观之，则物与我皆无尽也”。
examples.en: He copied this passage into a farewell message.

story.en: Part of Su Shi's answer to the guest's grief: whether the world seems fleeting or eternal depends on how one looks at it.
story.zh: 《赤壁赋》中苏轼劝慰客人的核心论述：世界是短暂还是永恒，取决于观察的角度。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 惟江上之清风，与山间之明月，耳得之而为声，目遇之而成色，取之无禁，用之不竭
pinyin: wéi jiāng shàng zhī qīng fēng, yǔ shān jiān zhī míng yuè, ěr dé zhī ér wéi shēng, mù yù zhī ér chéng sè, qǔ zhī wú jìn, yòng zhī bù jié
literal: only · river · on · of · clear · breeze, and · hill · among · of · bright · moon, ear · gets · it · and · becomes · sound, eye · meets · it · and · forms · colour, take · it · no · ban, use · it · not · run out
natural: Only the clear breeze on the river and the bright moon among the hills: the ear takes them as sound and the eye as colour, no one forbids us to take them and we can never use them up

meaning.en: The best things in life, such as breeze and moonlight, are free and inexhaustible for anyone who enjoys them.
meaning.zh: 清风明月是自然赠予所有人的无尽财富，取用无禁、用之不竭。

equivalents: the best things in life are free

examples.zh: 周末爬山时，他笑着背起“惟江上之清风，与山间之明月，耳得之而为声，目遇之而成色，取之无禁，用之不竭”。
examples.en: Hiking at the weekend, he cheerfully recited this passage.

examples.zh: 她把“惟江上之清风，与山间之明月，耳得之而为声，目遇之而成色，取之无禁，用之不竭”写进了旅行日记。
examples.en: She wrote this passage in her travel diary.

story.en: Su Shi tells the guest that while nothing in the world is truly one's own, the breeze and moon are free for all to enjoy; the guest laughs and the party drinks on.
story.zh: 苏轼劝客：天地间物各有主，唯清风明月可以尽情享用；客人闻言而喜，开怀畅饮。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 山高月小，水落石出
pinyin: shān gāo yuè xiǎo, shuǐ luò shí chū
literal: hill · high · moon · small, water · fall · rock · appear
natural: The hills are high and the moon looks small; the water has fallen and the rocks stand out

meaning.en: Describes a clear winter river scene; today also used for the truth emerging once the surface settles.
meaning.zh: 原写冬日江景；今多用来比喻真相大白、事情终于明朗。

equivalents: the truth comes out

examples.zh: 等调查结束，自然“山高月小，水落石出”。
examples.en: When the investigation ends, the truth will come out.

examples.zh: 冬天的赤壁，正是“山高月小，水落石出”的景象。
examples.en: Winter at the Red Cliff is just the scene of this line.

story.en: In the Latter Ode, Su Shi returns to the Red Cliff in the tenth month and sees the scene changed by winter: this is how he describes the river.
story.zh: 出自《后赤壁赋》：十月之望，苏轼重游赤壁，描写江岸冬景，水落而石现。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 古之立大事者，不惟有超世之才，亦必有坚忍不拔之志
pinyin: gǔ zhī lì dà shì zhě, bù wéi yǒu chāo shì zhī cái, yì bì yǒu jiān rěn bù bá zhī zhì
literal: ancient · of · establish · great · affair · ones, not · only · have · beyond · age · of · talent, also · must · have · firm · enduring · unshakable · of · will
natural: Those of old who accomplished great deeds had not only extraordinary talent but also unshakable resolve

meaning.en: Great achievements need not just talent but also firm perseverance.
meaning.zh: 成就大事，不仅要有出众的才能，更要有坚韧不拔的意志。

equivalents: talent alone is not enough; grit makes the difference

examples.zh: 校长在开学典礼上引用“古之立大事者，不惟有超世之才，亦必有坚忍不拔之志”勉励新生。
examples.en: The principal quoted this line to encourage new students at the opening ceremony.

examples.zh: 作文要写毅力，可以用“古之立大事者，不惟有超世之才，亦必有坚忍不拔之志”开头。
examples.en: For an essay on perseverance you can open with this line.

story.en: In his essay on Chao Cuo, Su Shi argues that Chao failed because he lacked resolve; great enterprises demand both talent and perseverance.
story.zh: 苏轼《晁错论》评晁错削藩之败，指出成大事既要才华，也须有坚忍不拔的意志。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 天下有大勇者，卒然临之而不惊，无故加之而不怒
pinyin: tiān xià yǒu dà yǒng zhě, cù rán lín zhī ér bù jīng, wú gù jiā zhī ér bù nù
literal: world · under · have · great · courage · ones, suddenly · face · it · yet · not · startled, without · cause · inflicted · it · yet · not · angry
natural: A truly brave person is not startled when disaster strikes suddenly and does not rage when insulted for no reason

meaning.en: True courage is calm self-control: staying unruffled by sudden danger or unprovoked insult.
meaning.zh: 真正的勇者遇突发危险不惊慌，无故受辱也不愤怒，沉着克制。

equivalents: grace under pressure
keep cool in a crisis

examples.zh: 面对突发状况，他始终镇定自若，正应了“天下有大勇者，卒然临之而不惊，无故加之而不怒”。
examples.en: He stayed calm throughout the emergency, just as this line says.

examples.zh: 他引用“天下有大勇者，卒然临之而不惊，无故加之而不怒”提醒自己遇事要沉住气。
examples.en: He quotes this line to remind himself to stay calm.

story.en: In his essay on Zhang Liang (Marquis of Liu), Su Shi explains that Zhang's patience after being humbled by the old man Huang Shigong is the mark of great courage.
story.zh: 苏轼《留侯论》论张良：圯上老人当众折辱他，他能忍而不怒，正是大勇的表现。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 何夜无月？何处无竹柏？但少闲人如吾两人者耳
pinyin: hé yè wú yuè, hé chù wú zhú bǎi, dàn shǎo xián rén rú wú liǎng rén zhě ěr
literal: which · night · lack · moon? which · place · lack · bamboo · cypress? only · lack · idle · people · like · we · two · people · ones · !
natural: What night has no moon, and what place no bamboo and cypress? There are just few idle people like the two of us

meaning.en: Beauty is everywhere; what is rare is someone with the leisure and mood to notice it.
meaning.zh: 美景处处皆有，缺少的是有闲情逸致去欣赏的人。

equivalents: beauty is everywhere if you take the time to see it

examples.zh: 忙碌的人哪有时间看夜色？“何夜无月？何处无竹柏？但少闲人如吾两人者耳”。
examples.en: Busy people have no time for the night sky; this is what the line means.

examples.zh: 他把“何夜无月？何处无竹柏？但少闲人如吾两人者耳”做成了朋友圈签名。
examples.en: He made this line his social-media signature.

story.en: Su Shi, exiled in Huangzhou, could not sleep one moonlit night, went to Chengtian Temple and found his friend Zhang Huaimin also awake; they strolled together.
story.zh: 苏轼贬黄州时，某夜月色入户，欣然起行，至承天寺寻张怀民，二人相与步于中庭。

usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 千门万户曈曈日，总把新桃换旧符
pinyin: qiān mén wàn hù tóng tóng rì, zǒng bǎ xīn táo huàn jiù fú
literal: thousand · gates · ten thousand · households · bright · bright · sun, always · take · new · peach · swap · old · charms
natural: On every household's door in the rising sun, new peach-wood charms replace the old

meaning.en: A scene of the Spring Festival: the new year brings new things; also used for out with the old, in with the new.
meaning.zh: 写春节家家户户换桃符的景象；也比喻除旧布新、万象更新。

equivalents: out with the old, in with the new

examples.zh: 春节前夕，家家贴春联，真是“千门万户曈曈日，总把新桃换旧符”。
examples.en: On the eve of the Spring Festival every home hangs couplets: this line in action.

examples.zh: 改革的新气象，正如“千门万户曈曈日，总把新桃换旧符”。
examples.en: The fresh look of reform is just like this line.

story.en: Written by Wang Anshi, then a reformist chancellor, on New Year's Day; firecrackers, spiced wine and swapping the door charms stand for renewal.
story.zh: 王安石《元日》：写新年爆竹、屠苏酒和换桃符的景象，亦寄托革新除旧的政治抱负。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.

text: 春风又绿江南岸，明月何时照我还
pinyin: chūn fēng yòu lǜ jiāng nán àn, míng yuè hé shí zhào wǒ huán
literal: spring · wind · again · greens · river · south · bank, bright · moon · when · shine · me · return
natural: The spring breeze has again turned the south bank green; when will the bright moon light my way home?

meaning.en: Homesickness: spring comes round again, but when can I go home?
meaning.zh: 表达思乡之情：春天又到江南，我何时才能回家。

equivalents: homesick as spring returns

examples.zh: 每到春天，漂泊在外的他就会想起“春风又绿江南岸，明月何时照我还”。
examples.en: Every spring, he, living far from home, thinks of this line.

examples.zh: 过年没能回家，她在日记里写下“春风又绿江南岸，明月何时照我还”。
examples.en: Unable to go home for the New Year, she wrote this line in her diary.

story.en: Wang Anshi moored at Guazhou on the Yangtze, within sight of Zhongshan (Nanjing) where he lived; the verb 绿 was said to be chosen after many drafts.
story.zh: 王安石泊船瓜洲，隔江遥望钟山，思归之情油然而生；“绿”字相传几经推敲而定。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.

text: 世之奇伟、瑰怪、非常之观，常在于险远，而人之所罕至焉，故非有志者不能至也
pinyin: shì zhī qí wěi, guī guài, fēi cháng zhī guān, cháng zài yú xiǎn yuǎn, ér rén zhī suǒ hǎn zhì yān, gù fēi yǒu zhì zhě bù néng zhì yě
literal: world · of · wondrous · grand, rare · strange, extraordinary · of · sights, often · lie · in · perilous · remote, and · people · of · seldom · reach · there, therefore · not · have · will · ones · not · can · reach
natural: The world's most wondrous and extraordinary sights lie in dangerous, remote places that few people reach, so only the determined can get there

meaning.en: The finest rewards lie in hard-to-reach places and only those with resolve will reach them.
meaning.zh: 最奇妙壮丽的景观往往在险远之处，只有有志向、肯付出的人才能到达。

equivalents: no pain, no gain
the best views come after the hardest climb

examples.zh: 登顶后他感慨：“世之奇伟、瑰怪、非常之观，常在于险远，而人之所罕至焉，故非有志者不能至也”。
examples.en: After reaching the summit he sighed with this line.

examples.zh: 老师借“世之奇伟、瑰怪、非常之观，常在于险远，而人之所罕至焉，故非有志者不能至也”鼓励学生攻难关。
examples.en: The teacher used this line to encourage students to tackle hard problems.

story.en: In his travel record of Mount Baochan, Wang Anshi tells how he and friends turned back from a deep cave and regretted it, drawing a lesson about perseverance.
story.zh: 王安石《游褒禅山记》：作者与友人游华山洞，因火把将尽而退出，事后悔憾，由此悟出立志与坚持的道理。

text: 一水护田将绿绕，两山排闼送青来
pinyin: yī shuǐ hù tián jiāng lǜ rào, liǎng shān pái tà sòng qīng lái
literal: one · stream · guard · fields · take · green · circle, two · hills · push · door · send · green · come
natural: A stream guards the fields, winding round them in green; two hills push open the door and bring their greenery in

meaning.en: Vivid personification of nature, with a stream and hills seeming to embrace and greet the viewer.
meaning.zh: 运用拟人手法，写溪水环绕田野、青山推门而入的生动景象。

equivalents: nature embracing the countryside

examples.zh: 车驶出隧道，窗外正是“一水护田将绿绕，两山排闼送青来”的美景。
examples.en: The car leaves the tunnel and outside is a scene just like this line.

examples.zh: 他在作文里引用“一水护田将绿绕，两山排闼送青来”描写乡村。
examples.en: He quotes this line in his essay describing the countryside.

story.en: Wang Anshi wrote it on the wall of his neighbour Yang Deyi's house at Nanjing, praising the clean courtyard and the scenery outside.
story.zh: 王安石为邻居杨德逢（号湖阴先生）题壁，赞其庭院洁净、景色宜人。

text: 登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣
pinyin: dēng sī lóu yě, zé yǒu xīn kuàng shén yí, chǒng rǔ xié wàng, bǎ jiǔ lín fēng, qí xǐ yáng yáng zhě yǐ
literal: ascend · this · tower · , then · have · heart · broad · spirit · glad, favour · disgrace · both · forgotten, hold · wine · face · breeze, its · joy · brimming · ones · !
natural: Climbing this tower, one feels light of heart and glad of spirit, forgets both honour and disgrace, and raises a cup to the breeze, brimming with joy

meaning.en: On a high viewpoint, worries fade and one feels carefree and joyful.
meaning.zh: 登高远望，心胸开阔，忘却得失荣辱，喜悦洋溢。

equivalents: on top of the world
forget all one's worries

examples.zh: 登上山顶，他不禁感叹“登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣”。
examples.en: Atop the mountain he could not help quoting this line.

examples.zh: 假期结束，大家都想再找回“登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣”的轻松。
examples.en: As the holiday ends, everyone wants to recapture the carefree feeling of this line.

story.en: In Fan Zhongyan's 1046 essay for the rebuilt Yueyang Tower, this describes the joy of viewing the lake in fair weather, balancing the gloom of stormy weather.
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》写晴日登楼观景之乐，与阴雨时的悲怀相对照。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.

text: 长烟一空，皓月千里，浮光跃金，静影沉璧
pinyin: cháng yān yī kōng, hào yuè qiān lǐ, fú guāng yuè jīn, jìng yǐng chén bì
literal: long · mist · once · clear, bright · moon · thousand · li, floating · light · leaps · gold, still · shadow · sinks · jade disc
natural: The long mist clears and a bright moon shines for a thousand li; floating light leaps like gold and the still reflection sinks like a jade disc

meaning.en: A famous description of moonlight on Dongting Lake.
meaning.zh: 描写洞庭湖月夜的名句，月光洒在湖面，静美如画。

equivalents: moonlight on a calm lake

examples.zh: 湖边的夜晚，让他想起“长烟一空，皓月千里，浮光跃金，静影沉璧”。
examples.en: The lakeside night reminds him of this line.

examples.zh: 语文课要求背诵“长烟一空，皓月千里，浮光跃金，静影沉璧”。
examples.en: The Chinese class requires memorising this line.

story.en: In the essay's account of fine weather at Dongting Lake from the tower, moonlit water gleams like gold and the reflection of the moon is like a sunken jade disc.
story.zh: 出自《岳阳楼记》：写春和景明、月夜洞庭的景象，月影沉于水中如璧。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 浊酒一杯家万里，燕然未勒归无计
pinyin: zhuó jiǔ yī bēi jiā wàn lǐ, yān rán wèi lè guī wú jì
literal: cloudy · wine · one · cup · home · ten thousand · li, Yanran · not yet · carved · return · no · plan
natural: A cup of rough wine, and home is ten thousand li away; Yanran is not yet won and there is no way to return

meaning.en: A soldier on the frontier longs for home but cannot leave until the war is won.
meaning.zh: 戍边将士思乡心切，但战事未了，不能归去。

equivalents: torn between duty and homesickness

examples.zh: 戍边的战士读到“浊酒一杯家万里，燕然未勒归无计”，不禁红了眼眶。
examples.en: The border soldier reads this line and his eyes redden.

examples.zh: 这句“浊酒一杯家万里，燕然未勒归无计”写出了将士的两难。
examples.en: This line captures the soldier's dilemma.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan wrote it while defending the northwest border against Western Xia; 燕然未勒 alludes to Dou Xian carving a victory inscription on Mount Yanran.
story.zh: 范仲淹镇守西北边防抗击西夏时所作；“燕然未勒”用东汉窦宪勒石燕然山之典，指战功未成。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 酒入愁肠，化作相思泪
pinyin: jiǔ rù chóu cháng, huà zuò xiāng sī lèi
literal: wine · enter · sorrowing · bowels, turn · into · longing · tears
natural: When wine enters a sorrowful heart it turns to tears of longing

meaning.en: Drinking to drown sorrows only brings out tears of missing someone.
meaning.zh: 借酒浇愁，酒入愁肠反而化成思念的泪水。

equivalents: drowning one's sorrows only brings tears

examples.zh: 他喝了几杯，真是“酒入愁肠，化作相思泪”。
examples.en: He drank a few cups, and the line proved true.

examples.zh: 歌词里唱的“酒入愁肠，化作相思泪”让很多人感同身受。
examples.en: The lyric 'wine turns to tears of longing' speaks to many people.

story.en: In this autumn song of homesickness, Fan Zhongyan describes a traveller who drinks to ease sorrow, but the wine only turns to tears of longing.
story.zh: 范仲淹《苏幕遮·怀旧》：秋景萧瑟，羁旅之人欲借酒消愁，却化作相思之泪。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 江上往来人，但爱鲈鱼美。君看一叶舟，出没风波里
pinyin: jiāng shàng wǎng lái rén, dàn ài lú yú měi, jūn kàn yī yè zhōu, chū mò fēng bō lǐ
literal: river · on · come · go · people, only · love · perch · fish · delicious, you · look · one · leaf · boat, emerge · vanish · wind · waves · in
natural: People come and go on the river, caring only that the perch is delicious; look at that leaf of a boat, vanishing and reappearing in the wind and waves

meaning.en: A reminder that the comforts of the well-off depend on others who risk their lives to provide them.
meaning.zh: 提醒人们享用美食时，别忘了背后冒着风浪、艰辛劳作的人。

equivalents: spare a thought for those who risk their lives for your dinner

examples.zh: 吃着海鲜，他想起“江上往来人，但爱鲈鱼美。君看一叶舟，出没风波里”。
examples.en: Eating seafood, he thought of this poem.

examples.zh: 老师用“江上往来人，但爱鲈鱼美。君看一叶舟，出没风波里”教我们体恤劳动者。
examples.en: The teacher used this poem to teach us to feel for working people.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan saw fishermen's boats tossed on the waves while diners praised the fish, and wrote this poem out of sympathy.
story.zh: 范仲淹见渔舟在风浪中出没，而岸上之人只爱鲈鱼之美，感而作此诗。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 满目山河空念远，落花风雨更伤春。不如怜取眼前人
pinyin: mǎn mù shān hé kōng niàn yuǎn, luò huā fēng yǔ gèng shāng chūn, bù rú lián qǔ yǎn qián rén
literal: full · eye · hills · rivers · in vain · long for · far, falling · flowers · wind · rain · more · grieve · spring, better · not · cherish · take · before · eye · person
natural: Gazing at hills and rivers I long in vain for the far away; in wind and rain over fallen blossoms I grieve more for spring; better to cherish the one before my eyes

meaning.en: Do not pine for what is far or lost; treasure the person who is with you now.
meaning.zh: 与其空想远方的人和逝去的春光，不如珍惜眼前人。

equivalents: cherish those who are with you
a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush

examples.zh: 异地恋久了他才懂得“满目山河空念远，落花风雨更伤春。不如怜取眼前人”。
examples.en: Only after a long long-distance relationship did he understand this line.

examples.zh: 她在婚礼誓词里引用“满目山河空念远，落花风雨更伤春。不如怜取眼前人”。
examples.en: She quoted this line in her wedding vows.

origin.source: 晏殊《浣溪沙·一向年光有限身》

story.en: In this song by Yan Shu, after sighing at life's brevity, partings and fading spring, he concludes with this advice.
story.zh: 晏殊《浣溪沙》：感叹年光有限、离别常在、春光易逝之后，以此句作结，劝人珍惜当下。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 去年元夜时，花市灯如昼。月上柳梢头，人约黄昏后
pinyin: qù nián yuán yè shí, huā shì dēng rú zhòu, yuè shàng liǔ shāo tóu, rén yuē huáng hūn hòu
literal: last · year · first-month · night · time, flower · market · lamps · like · day, moon · rise · willow · tip · head, person · date · dusk · after
natural: Last year on Lantern Night the flower market blazed with lights like day; the moon rose above the willow tips and we met after dusk

meaning.en: A romantic memory of a lovers' tryst at the Lantern Festival, as in 月上柳梢头.
meaning.zh: 回忆去年元宵与恋人黄昏相约的甜蜜情景。

equivalents: a lantern-festival rendezvous

examples.zh: 元宵节的夜里，情侣们携手赏灯，真如“去年元夜时，花市灯如昼。月上柳梢头，人约黄昏后”。
examples.en: On Lantern Festival night couples stroll hand in hand, just like this poem.

examples.zh: 她看着旧照片，想起了“去年元夜时，花市灯如昼。月上柳梢头，人约黄昏后”。
examples.en: Looking at old photos, she remembered this scene.

story.en: Traditionally attributed to Ouyang Xiu (some editions credit Zhu Shuzhen): the first half recalls last year's Lantern Festival date; the second half finds the lover absent this year.
story.zh: 相传为欧阳修所作（部分版本题为朱淑真）：上片回忆去年元夕幽会，下片写今年人去楼空。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。
